question: Are the sayings that frequently appear in Garfiel's lines from ancient Lugnica?? Or are they his own creations? Personally, I'm almost finished reading arc four, so this birthday came at the perfect time!
answer: Some of them are from ancient Lugnica, and some are Garfiel's own creation. More commonly his own creations, in fact. Having said that, he does in fact like reading and has lot of old Lugnican tales in his head, so it's less that their completely baseless, and more like he's newly creating his own sayings. That makes him sound smart, but basically it's just that characters that use sayings are cool.
